meta.listDescription: Deadlock builds with measured win rates: meta builds, builds by top-ranked players, and community favorites.
meta.detailDescription: {build}, a {hero} build for Deadlock: measured win rate, item timing, item flow and ability order.
meta.detailDescriptionByAuthor: {build}, a {hero} build by {author} for Deadlock: measured win rate, item timing, item flow and ability order.

list.title: Builds
list.description: Win rates count matches where a build was selected at game start. Labels only appear when the data meets their rule.

meta.label: Meta builds
meta.definition: Builds with 200+ tracked matches, ordered by how far their win-rate interval sits above the hero’s own win rate.

pro.label: Pro builds
pro.definition: Builds by authors currently ranked {rankA} or {rankB} (rank at their latest ranked match).

list.selectionNote: Win rates count matches where the build was selected at game start; switching builds mid-match isn’t tracked.
list.noMatchMeta: No build has 200+ tracked matches in this scope. Try 30 days or all ranks.
list.noMatchPro: None of the {count} most-favorited builds here is by an author currently ranked {rankA} or {rankB}.

card.noMatches: No tracked matches in this scope

bestPerforming.rule: Win-rate interval above every other tracked build for this hero

highPerforming.rule: Win-rate interval entirely above the hero’s own win rate

frequentlyUsed.rule: Among the 3 most-selected tracked builds for this hero

popular.rule: Among the 10 most-favorited builds this week

patch.older: Not updated since the current patch

detail.whyDescription: The measured case for (or against) this build. Facts only; nothing here is a recommendation the data doesn’t support.
detail.rankScopeText: {scope}. Change the filters above to see the same build in another rank band or window.
detail.phasesDescription: Placed by when players of this hero actually buy each item on average, not by the author’s section names.
detail.abilityDescription: The author’s plan: ● unlock, I–III upgrade level. Read from the build’s data structure.
detail.noPlan: This build has no ability plan.
detail.openingComparison: For comparison: the most common first {count} upgrades in real matches ({share} of tracked orders, {winRate} win rate).
detail.performanceDescription: Matches where this build was selected at game start.
detail.noPerformance: No tracked matches for this build in this scope, so its performance can’t be measured. Try a 30-day window or all ranks.
detail.trackedBuilds: {count} {hero} builds have tracked matches in this scope. Switching builds mid-match isn’t tracked.
detail.timingDescription: Average purchase time for this build’s items across all {hero} players in this scope.
detail.flowDescription: Where this build’s items sit in the typical purchase flow for this hero.
detail.noFlow: No item-flow data for this build’s items in this scope.

why.popularityRankText: {favorites} favorites this week, {rank} of {total} {hero} builds listed.
why.noMatchesText: No tracked matches with this build selected at game start ({scope}). Its performance can’t be measured yet.
why.sampleText: {matches} tracked matches ({scope}); {sample, select, low {low} moderate {moderate} other {high}} sample. {tracked} {hero} builds have tracked matches in this scope.
why.winRateText: {winRate} when selected at game start, {delta} vs {hero} overall. {comparison}
why.compareLow: Too few matches to compare reliably.
why.compareAbove: Its 95% interval ({low}–{high}) is entirely above the hero’s {heroRate}.
why.compareBelow: Its 95% interval ({low}–{high}) is entirely below the hero’s {heroRate}.
why.compareOverlap: Its 95% interval ({low}–{high}) includes the hero’s {heroRate}: no clear difference.
why.timingText: {timed} of {total} items have purchase-time data for {hero}; {core} land in the 10–25 min core window. The latest, {item}, is bought around {time} on average.
why.flowText: {above} of {total} items with flow data have a wealth-adjusted win rate above the {baseline} baseline for {hero}. Adjusted rates are still observational.

phases.noItems: No items from this build in this window.
phases.untimed: Situational or rarely bought (not enough purchases on this hero to time):

timing.empty: No timing data for this build’s items in this scope.
timing.caption: Average purchase time and purchase rate for this build’s items on this hero

flow.nextTitle: Common next purchases within this build
flow.explanation: Adjusted win rate re-weights each purchase to the same net-worth mix, separating the item from the buyer’s lead (computed by the data source). It is still observational, not a controlled test.

performance.scale: Scale {scale}, center line 50%. Light whisker = this build’s 95% interval.
